field.label: Enable LightScope
field.help: Enable or disable the LightScope security monitoring service.

field.label: Honeypot Ports
field.help: Comma-separated list of TCP ports to forward to the USC honeypot for analysis. You can view your honeypot data on the Full Dashboard. Example input: 8080,2323,8443,3389,5900

field.label: Automatic Updates
field.help: Enable automatic plugin updates (recommended). Updates are checked every 15 minutes and installed automatically when available. Disabling this is not recommended as you may miss important security updates.
